info.description: API documentation for Learning and Development

post.description: Validates credentials, revokes any previously issued tokens for that user, and issues a new Sanctum token along with the user's roles and permissions.

office.example: OFFICE OF THE CITY INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY MANAGEMENT OFFICER

422.description: Invalid credentials. NOTE: current implementation throws this as 500 — see note below.

500.description: Server error (also currently returned for invalid credentials — see note below)

post.description: Creates a new user account linked to an employee (via control_no), assigns a role and optional direct permissions, and returns an authentication token.

username.description: Must be unique in the users table

control_no.description: Employee control number (links user to xPersonal/xService record)

office.description: Office already provided on the employee
office.example: OFFICE OF THE CITY INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY MANAGEMENT OFFICER

role.description: Must exist in the roles table (guard: sanctum)

permissions.description: Optional. Direct permissions granted on top of the role's permissions. Each value must exist in the permissions table.

data.description: Tuple: [0] = created user object (with roles/permissions loaded), [1] = Sanctum plain-text token

office.example: OFFICE OF THE CITY INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY MANAGEMENT OFFICER

roles.description: Full role model objects (not yet resource-transformed)

permissions.description: Direct permission model objects only (not role-inherited)

422.description: Validation error (e.g. duplicate username, role/permission not found)

message.example: The username has already been taken.

username: The username has already been taken.

500.description: Server error

post.description: Revokes only the Sanctum token used to authenticate the current request (other active sessions/tokens are untouched).

get.description: Returns a single event with its form, office, speaker, and schedule relations. Returns success with null data if not found (Eloquent find() returns null; not currently converted to a 404/error).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: ID of the event to view

post.description: Creates a new event with its related form(s), office(s), speaker(s), and schedule(s) inside a DB transaction. 'created_by' is set from the authenticated user's name. 'status' defaults to 'Pending'.

requestBody.description: Inferred from EventService::create() — verify against EventCreateRequest rules.

200.description: Created successfully. 'data' is the newly created event with form/office/schedule/speaker relations loaded.

422.description: Validation error (per EventCreateRequest rules — not verified here)

message.example: The title name field is required.

title_name: The title name field is required.

500.description: Server error, including a failed create (see EventService::create).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: ID of the event to delete

post.description: Bulk-creates nominated employee records. Rejects duplicate (event_id, control_no) pairs both within the submitted payload and against existing records. Each created record is stamped with the authenticated user's office. Runs inside a DB transaction.

office.example: OFFICE OF THE CITY INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY MANAGEMENT OFFICER

500.description: Server error, including duplicate control_no within the request or against existing records (currently returned as 500, not 422 — see EmployeeService::create).

message.example: Employee with control_no 2026-00123 is already nominated for this event.

delete.description: Deletes a nominated employee record by ID. Note: the route parameter is concatenated directly onto 'delete' with no separating slash (e.g. /api/employee/delete5).

parameters.name: nominatedId
parameters.description: ID of the nominated employee record to delete

200.description: Deleted successfully. 'data' contains the record's attributes as they were immediately before deletion.

office.example: OFFICE OF THE CITY INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY MANAGEMENT OFFICER

500.description: Server error, including 'not found' (currently returned as 500, not 404 — see EmployeeService::delete).

get.description: Returns all office records (officeId and office_name only). Always returns HTTP 200, including when the list is empty — there is no 'no records found' branch.

500.description: Unhandled server error (uncaught exception — no custom error envelope for this endpoint).

get.summary: List employees in the authenticated user's office
get.description: Returns employees (from the vwEmployee view) whose office matches the authenticated user's office. Always returns HTTP 200, including when the list is empty.
